proposal.quote: # Marrowfin Cloudworks: Ternlake Queue Availability Credit Terms

This is an independently invented, synthetic public contract. Marrowfin Cloudworks, its service and its contact address are fictional. This public document is expressly authorized for public model extraction. It conveys no real commercial authority.

These terms apply to the paid Westhaven queue endpoint of Ternlake Queue. They do not apply to its Eastmere endpoint, preview queues, the management console or any other service. Availability is measured separately for Westhaven for each complete UTC calendar month, from midnight on the first day through, but not including, midnight on the first day of the next month. Every second in that month remains in the denominator.

scope.product: paid Westhaven queue endpoint of Ternlake Queue

proposal.quote: A covered interruption occurs when all otherwise valid enqueue requests to Westhaven fail because the provider-operated dispatch controller serving that endpoint has failed. Only that event and cause are covered. Failure of customer credentials or code, customer rate-limit exhaustion, transit failure outside the provider boundary and failure of a different endpoint are excluded. Planned maintenance is excluded only when it caused the interruption, its window was announced at least 48 hours before it began, and the interruption falls within that announced window. Any time outside that window must be assessed on its own cause.

symptoms: all otherwise valid enqueue requests to Westhaven fail
provider_causes: the provider-operated dispatch controller serving that endpoint has failed
exclusions: Failure of customer credentials or code
transit failure outside the provider boundary

proposal.quote: Count the elapsed seconds of covered interruptions, including fractions of a second. Overlapping evidence for the same interruption counts only once. Availability is 100 multiplied by one minus covered seconds divided by all seconds in the month. Do not round availability before comparing it with the following table. Each boundary is strict: equality does not satisfy “below.” Apply the single largest applicable percentage, without adding tiers together.

The credit base is the monthly recurring charge for the affected Westhaven endpoint after discounts allocated to that endpoint. Exclude charges for other resources, usage charges, support charges and taxes. Multiply that base by the applicable credit percentage and round once to the nearest cent, with an exact half-cent rounded upward. The credit cannot exceed that base.

Send a claim to credit-desk@marrowfin.invalid after the measured month has ended. It must be received no later than 23:59:59 UTC on the twentieth calendar day of the following month. Include the measured month, affected endpoint, interruption intervals, evidence of the covered controller failure, evidence that valid requests failed and billing evidence tying the recurring charge to that endpoint. A missing item may be supplied through the same channel, but it must arrive by that same deadline. A denial does not restart the filing clock.

request_fields: evidence of the covered controller failure
billing evidence tying the recurring charge to that endpoint

proposal.quote: An approved credit is applied only to a future invoice for the service. It is not a cash payment, refund, alteration of an already issued invoice or permission to withhold payment. Previously granted credits for the same endpoint and measured month reduce any remaining credit; a supplemented claim does not create a second award.
